test_poll: test the poll function to retry HTTP requests until a dataset endpoint returns a non-retryable response
test_poll_until_ready_and_assert: test the poll_until_ready_and_assert function to wait for a dataset endpoint and assert status code and error headers
create_tmp_dataset: create a temporary Hugging Face dataset repo with files, yield its name, and auto-delete it on exit
test_get_openapi_body_example: test the get_openapi_body_example function to extract an OpenAPI response example by path, status code, and example name
test_post_refresh: test the post_refresh function to trigger a dataset update webhook on the Hugging Face datasets-server
